description: This file defines the 'CursoController' class, which handles HTTP requests related to course management such as adding, editing, deleting, and viewing courses within a Spring MVC application. It interacts with services and repositories to perform CRUD operations and manages request mappings and view rendering.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing HTTP requests for courses, including creation, editing, deletion, and detail viewing. Enforces role-based access control and interacts with service and repository layers.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the course addition form for a specific professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new course associated with a professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a course for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing course with specified professor and course IDs.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display a list of all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to delete a specific course.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display details of a specific course, including user enrollment status.
